name: Franz Josef and Fox Glaciers
summary: Franz Josef and Fox are two glaciers on New Zealand's wild West Coast, falling from the Southern Alps almost to the rainforest. Take a heli-hike onto the ice, walk the valley trails to glacier viewpoints, soak in rainforest hot pools, and catch the mirror reflections of Aoraki/Mount Cook in Lake Matheson at dawn.
seasonNote: Weather changes fast year round; keep a spare day for flights.
arrival: About 5 hours by car from Queenstown or 2 hours from Hokitika.
cashTip: Cards and tap payments work everywhere; tipping isn't expected.
